name: Olive Young
description: CJ Olive Young's global health & beauty mall runs its own Influencer Program under published terms on its global site: any holder of a social account (YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X or Weibo) can apply, approved influencers get a custom Reward Code/Link giving followers 5% off, earn 5-13% of sales as commission points depending on influencer revenue, tracked on a 30-day cookie, convertible to cash via PayPal once points reach USD 20.

evidence.summary: Olive Young Global's own Influencer Terms & Conditions (CJ Olive Young Co., Ltd.) govern the program: eligibility requires a social media account, approved members become Influencer Members, create a custom Reward Code automatically included in Reward Links, and sales are counted on a 30-day cookie with last-click attribution.

Article 6 of the brand's own terms: followers get a 5% discount via the Reward Code/Link and the influencer receives 5% - 13% of the sales amount as commission points depending on influencer revenues, with the exact rate designated by separately notified criteria; points post three days after delivery and convert to cash via PayPal at USD 20, withdrawn monthly. Because only a range is published and each member's rate is set separately, commission_rate is recorded as null. No earnings-cap statement and no absolute creator counts are published, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

reasons.credibility: Operated by CJ Olive Young, South Korea's dominant health & beauty retailer, under complete published legal terms.
